evidence: Touches src/index/ across BaseIndex and all secondary indexes (txindex, blockfilterindex, coinstatsindex, txospenderindex), refactoring synchronization and locking.
rationale: Removes index dependencies on node internals and stops holding cs_main during index notifications and sync, while resolving a startup race condition that triggered redundant rewinds. In the indexes category, refactors count substantially when they eliminate shared-lock contention (avoiding holding cs_main) and fix initial sync correctness hazards. It also unblocks running secondary indexes out-of-process.
